originalText: 有整数 a 和 b：a 至少是 2 且不超过 9，b 至少是 1 且不超过 9，a 恰好是 b 的两倍，并且 a+b 不超过 12。存在满足全部条件的 (a, b) 吗？
renderedSmt:
(set-logic QF_LIA)
(declare-fun a () Int)
(declare-fun b () Int)
(assert (>= a 2))
(assert (<= a 9))
(assert (>= b 1))
(assert (<= b 9))
(assert (= (+ a (* -2 b)) 0))
(assert (<= (+ a b) 12))
(check-sat)
(exit)
